G0.label: Quiet
G0.desc: Kp < 4. Geomagnetic activity is quiet, there is no space weather impact, and satellites need no protective action.

G1.label: Minor
G1.desc: Kp 4. Weak magnetic disturbance; aurora may show at high latitudes, with virtually no effect on satellites.

G2.label: Light-moderate
G2.desc: Kp 5. Aurora spreads equatorward, satellites may need attitude correction, grid transformers see occasional induced heating.

G3.label: Moderate
G3.desc: Kp 6. Surface charging on low-orbit satellites intensifies, attitude disturbance can exceed limits and needs active intervention.

G4.label: Strong
G4.desc: Kp 7. Satellite tracking becomes difficult, some low-orbit satellites may be lost, power grid and communications show anomalies.

G5.label: Severe
G5.desc: Kp 8. GPS accuracy drops sharply or service is unavailable, astronauts must shelter inside the module.

G6p.label: Extreme
G6p.desc: Kp 9. Rare in recorded history; GPS may be lost for a long time, power grids and communications are under threat.
